outputs.H01: Build a separate timeline for every clinical order showing when it was placed, checked and, if applicable, cancelled.
outputs.H02: For every clinical order, show the recorded times when its laboratory findings became available, its medicine was given or its procedure finished, as applicable.
outputs.H03: For every laboratory order, show when each measurement was charted, when its findings became accessible and when the order's results were verified.
outputs.H04: Create a timeline for each medication order covering dispensing, each dose given or not given, and the stopping of the medication.
outputs.H05: For every procedure order, show when preparation finished and when each procedure occurrence began and ended.
outputs.H06: For every hospital stay, show arrival registration in the emergency department, admission, authorization to leave and actual discharge.
outputs.H07: For each patient, collect the recorded hospital entries and departures, availability of laboratory findings, medicine administrations and finishes of procedures.
outputs.H08: For every clinical order, show when its insurance claim was settled by payment.
outputs.HF01: Build a complete timeline of all recorded care events for every patient.
outputs.HF02: Show the entire recorded history of each individual hospital stay.
outputs.HF03: Trace each clinical order through its complete recorded history.
outputs.HF04: Show everything recorded over the life of each laboratory order.
outputs.HF05: Build the complete recorded history of each medication order.
outputs.HF06: Trace the whole recorded lifecycle of every procedure order.

semantic_review: Assistant reviewed each output against its frozen seed for case/population/activity/answerability equivalence; exact ES and Gold identity are additionally checked by code. This is an author review, not independent paraphrase-quality evaluation.
